title: Custom 16x16 Tic-Tac-Toe Variant Game Logic
prompt:
Can you help me to create a tick tack toe variant game in HTML, javascript and CSS only. It needs to run with python -m http.server in the repo root.
For this iteration, lets focus on the logic of the game.

Firstly the rules of the game are:
1. the board will be a 16x16 grid (make it easily configurable though)
2. in the center of the board is a standard 9x9 square (highlight the edges in the UI)
3. each player must start by placing a O or and X in this square
4. there after, each player places a O or an X , but the new piece must be within one square of one of this players other pieces, i.e. there can be 1 empty square between the new piece and an existing piece.
5. The first player to get 3 rows or 4 or 1 row of 5 wins.
6. If a player gets a row of 3, they can remove one of the opposition pieces (but, if this piece formed a row of 4, the row of 4 count does not get decremented - in other words, once formed, a row of 4 counts for the duration of the game).

Next, our data structures:
I think we will need 1. a 2D array to store the positions on the board, a simpler row of 4 counter for each player.
Each position in the 2d data structure will need to store whether it has been counted as a row of 4 or as a row of 3, so it does not get double counted, and which player it belongs to (or is empty). Can you give me a suggestion for what this looks like. Is there anything else we need to store.

Next, can you check if there is an off the shelf algorithm or library we can use to check for rows of 3, 4 and 5. 
Each time a player places a piece, we need to check for rows of 3, 4 and 5 that have not already been counted.
After the player places a piece, we should provide a 2d array showing valid place for the next player to place their next piece based on empty slots that are within 3 squares any other pieces belonging to this player - can you check if there is an algorithm we can use for this.

Finally, can you write the game rules to docs/RULES.md.
